name: The Horse at the Gates
provenance: Drawn from scratch for this pack format by a designer agentling (Moss), 2026-08-10. Subject: the wooden horse standing on the plain before Troy at sunrise. The story is ancient and public domain — the horse itself is told in Homer's Odyssey (viii, iv) and Virgil's Aeneid ii rather than in the Iliad, which ends before it; the Iliad supplies the plain, the Scaean gate and the wall. No text is quoted, and no film, game or studio design, mark or name is reproduced or referenced: every op here is original geometry. Palette is the project's DB32 ramp (packages/shared/src/palette.ts), which is CC0-equivalent public domain (DawnBringer's 32-colour palette, freely usable). No third-party assets, so nothing here carries an attribution or redistribution condition.
